title: Amsar da Ta Kai Ga Al'arshi
intro: Wani mutum mai nauyin nauyi ya kusanci kujerar shari'a, muryarsu tana rawa ba tare da tsoro ba amma da bege. Al'amarin na sirri ne, duk da haka ƙudurinsa zai yi ta maimaitawa a kowane lokaci, yana wargaza al'adar zalunci. Wace irin rai ce wannan da aka ji ƙarar fiye da taurari?
clues: Na zo da zuciya mai nauyi, ina neman adalci a cikin wani lamari da ya ɗaure min harshe.
Roƙona ba ga manzo kawai ba ne; ya wuce gona da iri, ga wanda yake jin komai.
Kalmomin da aka yi mini a kaina kamar sarƙoƙi ne na tsohon tarihi.
Na yi jayayya da tunani, da hawaye da kuma dabaru, don girmama ni.
Wani wahayi ya sauko, yana rufe tsoffin hanyoyin kuma yana yarda da azabata.
Suna kirana wanda ya yi jayayya game da mijina, kuma sunana ya zama daidai da babin da ya 'yantar da ni.

identity.label: Wanene Ni?
options: Matar da ta yi jayayya game da mijinta (Khawla bint Tha'laba)
identity.answer: Matar da ta yi jayayya game da mijinta (Khawla bint Tha'laba)

trial.label: Shari'a ko Abin da Ya Faru
options: An zarge ta da rashin tsarkin zuciya
Ba ta da haihuwa kuma tana sha'awar haihuwa
Ta fuskanci wata mummunar al'ada ta saki
Ita sarauniya ce tana tattaunawa da wani annabi
trial.answer: Ta fuskanci wata mummunar al'ada ta saki

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An albarkace ta da ɗa a tsufa
Ta sami wahayi na allahntaka wanda ya kawar da al'adar
An ba ta ɗa wanda ya zama annabi
outcome.answer: Ta sami wahayi na allahntaka wanda ya kawar da al'adar

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
